name: Phishing Kill Chain — DNS Resolution of Known-Bad Domain
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type in ("DNS Query","DNS Response","Threat")
| filter xdm.event.description contains "credential-stealer"
       or xdm.event.description contains "command-control"
       or xdm.event.description contains "phishing-kit"
       or xdm.event.description contains "phishing-login"
       or xdm.event.description contains "malware-distro"
       or xdm.event.description contains "ransomware-payload"
       or xdm.event.description contains "exploit-kit"
| alter src_ip = coalesce(xdm.source.ipv4, arrayindex(regextract(infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log, "src=(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0)),
        domain = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "query: (\S+) IN"), 0)
| filter src_ip != null
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count() as bad_events,
       count_distinct(domain) as distinct_bad_domains
       by src_ip, _time
| filter bad_events >= 3 and distinct_bad_domains >= 2
| fields src_ip
description: Internal host resolving phishing / C2 / malware-distro domain.
alert_name: Phishing Kill Chain — DNS Resolution of Known-Bad Domain
